content.title: HEALTHY HABITS THAT ARE SECRETLY WORKING {{AGAINST}} YOU
facts: **Drinking a gallon of water a day** -> can flush out sodium and leave you feeling foggy and fatigued instead of hydrated
**Sleeping in on weekends** -> shifts your internal clock and makes Monday mornings feel like jet lag
**Doing an intense workout every single day** -> keeps cortisol elevated and slows down muscle repair
**Eating a salad as your only meal** -> often leaves you under-fueled, causing energy crashes an hour later
**Taking long, hot showers before bed** -> can actually delay sleep onset if you hop straight under the covers after
**Snacking on dried fruit instead of candy** -> packs in more concentrated sugar per bite than you'd expect
**Standing at your desk all day** -> can pool blood in your legs and strain your lower back just like sitting too much
**Chewing gum to curb appetite** -> can trick your stomach into producing acid with nothing to digest
**Following along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these habits deserve a closer look. Take water intake — chugging it nonstop without replacing electrolytes can dilute your blood sodium, which is why some people feel dizzy or 'foggy' despite drinking plenty. Then there's the hot shower before bed: your body actually needs to cool down to trigger melatonin release, so jumping straight under warm blankets right after can cancel that effect out. And daily intense workouts — without rest days, your muscles don't get the window they need to actually rebuild stronger, so you can train hard and still feel weaker over time. Everyone's body responds differently, so pay attention to how yours reacts.
